QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann wants to talk to you at the Monster Park. He said it's regarding #b#t4310020#s#k. Meet with Spiegelmann.
QuestInfo.1:
You have been tasked with eliminating a boss in the Monster Park Advanced Dungeon.
Eliminate ONE of the following bosses: #o9800084#, #o9800091#, #o9800099#, #o9800105#, #o9800113#, #o9800186#, or #o9800119#.

0.0: The dungeons within the Monster Park are pretty exciting. If you haven't been there yet, you should go. Hey, have you collected some #b#t4310020#s#k? Should I help you?

If you can #bdefeat a dungeon Boss over Level 160#k, I'll give you 5 #b#t4310020##k items. That should turn your luck around, eh?

no.0: Oh, so you don't need any help? Heh, if you say so...

1.0: Heh, not bad. Here, this is for you.

yes.0: I'll give you a chance every day, so keep trying. Who knows? You might end up with your #t1012270# (5 Days) or #t1162008# (7 Days)!
